name: pdf-compressor
description: Local React UI + Express API that compresses PDFs with Ghostscript

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev:host"
